(SELECT 'region' as attr_type, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
FROM (
    SELECT region,
        CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) > 0 
            THEN (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) - SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24 THEN sales ELSE 0 END)) 
                 / SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
        END as pct_change
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020
    GROUP BY region
))

UNION ALL
